fusions.name: Feinting Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks a knife that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 15% chance to turn it against its allies for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Behind the Smile
fusions.desc: A stab that deals 28 damage, ignores armour and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Your movement speed rises 25% for 5 seconds after.

fusions.name: Card Up the Sleeve
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Loaded Odds
fusions.desc: Once every 12 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
